title: Mapping spaces in the coherent relative triple pullback
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be quasicategories and let $u^*:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be a simplicial functor. Form the coherent triple quasicategory
$$\mathcal T=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)\times_{\mathcal A,\operatorname{ev}_1,u^*}\mathcal B,$$
whose objects are $(A,F,\eta:A\to u^*F)$ and whose source projection is $r=\operatorname{ev}_0$. For triples $H=(A,F,\eta)$ and $K=(A',F',\eta')$, put
$$S=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal A}(A,A'),\quad V=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal A}(u^*F,u^*F'),\quad R=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal B}(F,F'),\quad M=\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)}(\eta,\eta').$$
The right-pinched mapping space in $\mathcal T$ is naturally isomorphic, degree by degree, to the strict pullback
$$M\times_{S\times V}(S\times R),$$
where $M\to S\times V$ records both endpoint maps and $S\times R\to S\times V$ is $(a,b)\mapsto(a,u^*(b))$. This isomorphism commutes with every simplicial operator, with the source projection to $S$, and with simplicial functors commuting with $u^*$ and the displayed endpoints.

proof.text: First justify the quasicategory in the statement. Apply [lem-coef-infinity-isofibration-exponentiation] to the inclusion of the last vertex $\{1\}\hookrightarrow\Delta^1$ and target $\mathcal A$. It gives an isofibration $e=\operatorname{ev}_1:\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)\to\mathcal A$ between quasicategories, hence an inner fibration. For an inner horn $\Lambda_i^k\to\mathcal T$, its $\mathcal B$-coordinate extends to $b:\Delta^k\to\mathcal B$ because $\mathcal B$ is a quasicategory. The given arrow-coordinate horn lies over $u^*b|_{\Lambda_i^k}$. The inner lifting property of $e$ extends it to $q:\Delta^k\to\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)$ with $eq=u^*b$. The pair $(q,b)$ fills the original horn in the defining degreewise pullback. Thus $\mathcal T$ is a quasicategory. This uses no lifting hypothesis on $u^*$.

source.place: Corollary 4.4.5.3 for evaluation at the last vertex; direct pullback horn lift using the definition of quasicategory.

proof.text: Fix $n\geq0$, and write $I_n=\Delta^{\{0,\ldots,n\}}\subseteq\Delta^{n+1}$. By [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], an $n$-simplex of $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal T}(H,K)$ is a map $\sigma:\Delta^{n+1}\to\mathcal T$ constant at $H$ on all of $I_n$ and with last vertex $K$. A map into the displayed degreewise pullback is exactly a pair $(q,b)$ with $q:\Delta^{n+1}\to\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)$, $b:\Delta^{n+1}\to\mathcal B$, and $\operatorname{ev}_1q=u^*b$ as simplicial maps. The boundary conditions on $\sigma$ say exactly that $q$ is constant at $\eta$ on $I_n$ and has last vertex $\eta'$, while $b$ is constant at $F$ on $I_n$ and has last vertex $F'$. Consequently $q\in M_n$ and $b\in R_n$, and the equality is precisely $(\operatorname{ev}_1)_*(q)=u^*_*(b)$ in $V_n$. Conversely any such pair defines $\sigma$ by the same coordinate formula; the two constructions are inverse.

source.place: Construction 4.6.5.1, expanded using the entire-initial-face right-pinched convention of def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones and the defining degreewise pullback.

proof.text: For $q\in M_n$, let $a=(\operatorname{ev}_0)_*(q)\in S_n$. Send the pair $(q,b)$ of step 2 to $(q,(a,b))$. Its two images in $(S\times V)_n$ agree: they are $(a,(\operatorname{ev}_1)_*(q))$ and $(a,u^*_*(b))$. This gives a map to the strict pullback in the conclusion. Conversely an element $(q,(a,b))$ of that pullback satisfies $a=(\operatorname{ev}_0)_*(q)$ and $(\operatorname{ev}_1)_*(q)=u^*_*(b)$, so forgetting $a$ gives exactly the pair of step 2. These maps are inverse in every degree. The source map $r$ applied to $\sigma$ is $\operatorname{ev}_0q=a$, which is precisely the displayed projection to $S$. All assertions here are equality of coordinates in the degreewise products and pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones].

source.place: Agent coordinate reassociation of the degreewise pullback; no homotopy-pullback comparison is used.

proof.text: For a monotone map $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$, extend it by the new last vertex to $\alpha^+:[m+1]\to[n+1]$. The right-pinched operator sends $(q,b)$ to $(q\Delta(\alpha^+),b\Delta(\alpha^+))$. Evaluation and postcomposition with $u^*$ commute with this restriction, so the formula of step 3 sends it to $(q\Delta(\alpha^+),((\operatorname{ev}_0q)\Delta(\alpha^+),b\Delta(\alpha^+)))$, exactly the coordinatewise operator on the claimed pullback. The degreewise inverse commutes as well, proving a simplicial isomorphism. For a strictly commuting square with functors $f:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A_1$, $g:\mathcal B\to\mathcal B_1$ and $fu^*=u_1^*g$, the induced map sends $(q,b)$ to $(\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,f)q,gb)$. Evaluation at either endpoint commutes with $f$, so step 3 commutes strictly with this map too. This proves the stated naturality, including the specified endpoints, using only the operator and internal-functor definitions in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones].
